newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's TRI down on mix of rumours.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's TRI down on mix of rumours.

text.p: A mix of negative rumours about Technology Resources Industries Bhd (TRI), which were denied by the telecommunications group, brought the stock to a new year-low on Monday, dealers and analysts said.
At the end of the morning session, TRI was down 20 cents to 6.35 ringgit, after falling to as low as 6.30. It was the most actively-traded stock, with volume of 7.03 million shares.

Analysts said worries over the billing system for its cellular phone network and perceptions of poor subscriber growth hit the stock. There was also talk that TRI's fixed line services partner, Deutsche Telekom, may pull out, they said.
